description: Identity doubted: Baugher says AH-1G 66-15343 (c/n 20099) was shot down 19 Apr 1972 near Dau Tieng and that the Bull Shoals helicopter marked 66-15434 (a serial outside the AH-1G block) must be another airframe; the Aerial Visuals Goldbook-derived history instead records recovery Jul 1972 then an ARADMAC rebuild then the 101st Airborne in 1974 then AH-1F conversion and transfer to the Hoevel-Barnett Post 1341 in Aug 2003 dedicated to Capt Arnold Rahm and 1Lt George Barsom III; taken on strength Dec 1967 (Aerial Visuals); removed for restoration 2013-15; satellite imagery and Google Street View of Sep 2025 show the Cobra on its pylon at the post
